title: Restricting a Kan fibration to component subcomplexes
statement: Use small simplicial sets, Kan complexes and Kan fibrations of [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper]. For a simplicial set $Z$, define $\pi_0Z$ to be the quotient of its vertices by the equivalence relation generated by the endpoints of every edge. For a subset $S\subseteq\pi_0Z$, let $Z[S]$ be the simplicial subset consisting of the simplices all of whose vertices represent elements of $S$; call it a union of components. Let $p:X\to Y$ be a Kan fibration of small simplicial sets, let $S\subseteq\pi_0X$ and $R\subseteq\pi_0Y$, and suppose $(\pi_0p)(S)\subseteq R$. Then restriction gives a Kan fibration $p_{S,R}:X[S]\to Y[R]$. For every vertex $y$ of $Y[R]$, the strict fiber of $p_{S,R}$ is the simplicial subset $X_y\cap X[S]$ of $X_y=X\times_Y\Delta^0$, and this subset is a union of components of $X_y$. These fibers are Kan complexes. Moreover, if $Z$ is Kan then every $Z[S]$ is Kan. Empty subsets, empty simplicial sets and empty fibers are allowed; neither $X$ nor $Y$ is required to be Kan.
